notes: Cash basis school district. Governmental total column (p6, fund columns on p5) used for receipts/disbursements; school nutrition is a special revenue fund inside the governmental funds, so business_type is null. Roll-forward: 43,588,250 + 152,940,892 - 160,529,928 + 5,525,000 - 5,525,000 = 35,999,214. Cash-basis beginning/ending use total fund balance (cash, county treasurer funds and investments combined; investments not separated). Local receipts 47,789,308 split into five receipts using the budget schedules (GF p7, Special Building p10, Bond p14): property tax 41,987,143, other taxes (PPD sales) 441,773, motor vehicle 4,410,889, tuition 147,391, other 802,112; property+PPD+MV = 46,839,805 = taxes collected on p2. Hidden transfers in GF schedule: 2600 plant line 13,946,152 recorded as 12,696,152 plus other financing -1,250,000 (to Special Building, p10); instruction lines (1100-1300, 3500, 6000 = 90,399,767 on p8 vs statement 86,949,767) carry contra expenditure line -3,450,000 plus other financing -3,450,000 (to Employee Benefit, p9) because the page does not say which line holds it. GF expenditure detail_total (133,323,579) includes other financing (8000 Transfers 825,000 to School Nutrition). Support services - pupils and maintenance and operation of plant lines split by fund columns on p5 (nutrition food service; special building capital outlay). Employee Benefit Fund is combined into the General Fund column on pp5-6 but has its own budget schedule (p9); its lines are separate from the General Fund schedule lines (p7-8), so not double counted (statement GF receipts 139,109,075 = schedule 139,063,123 + 45,952). Activities Fund recorded per account (more detailed); the one-line activities budget schedule is omitted, so no budget values. Student Fees schedule recorded from its budget lines (its per-account row is identical). Dashes in actual column recorded as 0. Read pages 1-14 of 14
